title: fix(app-shell): the Diagnostics page inside a package's Studio area sweeps only that package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbY8yy1z7weZjvcF9CG3bmqs)_

Fixes #29179

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio「全部元数据」区里，某个包内的诊断页现在只扫描这个包，和旁边的目录页一致;跨包入口(`~all`)和 Setup 的诊断页保持全环境扫描不变。
- **为什么改**:作者在包 A 里看到目录说「没有问题」，诊断页却列出别的包的无效项，点进去还跳到一个无关页面，无法找到要修的东西。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低，只多传一个包参数给已有的诊断请求(服务器早已支持按包过滤，目录页一直这样用);回滚即还原 `DiagnosticsPage.tsx` 一处改动。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DiagnosticsPage.tsx`(读取区域宿主并传 `packageId` 那一段);`DiagnosticsPage.packageScope-29179.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DiagnosticsPage.packageScope-29179.test.tsx`,预期 5 个用例全绿(在 main 上其中 3 个红)。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

`MetadataDiagnosticsPage` now reads the Studio area host (`useMetadataAreaHost()`) and passes `host.packageId` to `useGlobalDiagnostics` when the area is open on a package, the way `DirectoryPage` passes its `activePackage`. The request becomes `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics?severity=…&package=PKG`, so the page's count matches the directory's and every listed row is an item of the open package, whose area-relative link (`../TYPE/NAME`) opens that item in its own package's area.

Unchanged: the cross-package leg (`/studio/~all/metadata/_diagnostics`, `packageId: null`) and Setup's page (no area host) keep the environment-wide sweep (#28561). No copy, i18n key or exported type changes.

## Why

Inside `com.example.showcase`'s area the directory's scoped sweep found 0 issues (no "View all issues" link), while the Diagnostics page's unscoped sweep listed `pkga_qa_obj.qa_diag_view`, another package's item; its link resolved into the showcase area and landed on an unrelated Interfaces page. The server already filters the sweep by `packageId` at its list read, and diagnostics entries carry no package, so scoping the request is the whole fix.

## Tests

New `DiagnosticsPage.packageScope-29179.test.tsx` runs the real `useGlobalDiagnostics` against a fake client that answers as the server does (a `packageId` narrows the sweep), with the page nested at `ROOT/_diagnostics` as the area and Setup mount it:

- a package's area: the request carries the package, another package's invalid item is not listed, the page reads "All clear" (the card's scenario);
- a package's area: an own invalid item links to `/studio/PKG/metadata/view/NAME`;
- switching to Errors + Warnings keeps the package scope;
- the `~all` leg and Setup keep the environment-wide request and list the foreign row (preservation pins).

<details><summary>Red on main (ea150b7f), green on the fix</summary>

On `ea150b7f` with the test file alone: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`, the three package-area cases failing with `expected [ { severity: 'error' } ] to deeply equal [ { severity: 'error', …(1) } ]`, `expected` the foreign row's anchor element `to be null` and `expected { severity: 'warning' } to deeply equal { severity: 'warning', …(1) }`. The two preservation cases pass on main by design.

On the fix (`18d2b4cb`), with the two existing Diagnostics page tests: `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 12 passed (12)`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Setup's directory links `./_diagnostics` without its `?package=`, so Setup's Diagnostics page stays environment-wide beside a package-scoped directory count. This is outside the card's Studio reach and is left as is (noted, not fixed).
- Ablation: the red-on-main run above is the before leg (the same test against the unfixed page, imported from source, so no dist rebuild is involved).
